assumptions.reason: Process all files in the path (not just new ones).

blockers.message: S3 connectionName is required. Which Connections entry should this source use?
S3 paths is required. Provide the S3 path(s) as an array, e.g. ["s3://bucket/prefix/"].
S3 fileFormat is required. Specify CSV, JSON, or PARQUET.
S3 source schemaId is required. Which schema should be used to parse the files? (get the ID from the Schema Registry)
S3 formatOption is required for CSV files. Specify hasHeader (true/false) and delimiter character (e.g. ','  or '|').
